description: This file defines an immutable class `ImmutableJsonParseOptions` implementing the `JsonParseOptions` interface, encapsulating parsing options such as `applyUrlDecoding`. It includes factory methods, overrides for equality, hash code, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonParseOptions
classes.description: Immutable implementation of `JsonParseOptions`, representing JSON parsing options with an `applyUrlDecoding` flag.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new `ImmutableJsonParseOptions` instance with the specified `applyUrlDecoding` value.

methods.name: isApplyUrlDecoding
methods.description: Returns whether URL decoding should be applied during JSON parsing.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare `ImmutableJsonParseOptions` instances based on `applyUrlDecoding`.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to produce a hash based on `applyUrlDecoding`.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object.toString to provide a string representation including class name and `applyUrlDecoding` value.
